mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_report (user_id, target_type, target_id, reason, content, evidence_url, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{content}, #{evidenceUrl}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.sql: id, user_id, target_type, target_id, reason, content, evidence_url, status, admin_remark, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE content_report SET status = #{status}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_report WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
